plan: Given my value of $25, I should aim to bid just above the expected bids of Betty and Charles to maximize profit. Bidding exactly $25 or higher is dominated since it risks no profit or a loss. A reasonable bid is slightly above the midpoint of the value range, say $15, as it balances winning probability and profit margin.

To maximize profit, I should bid slightly above the maximum possible value for others, ensuring a win while minimizing payment. I'll bid $20.1, as it is unlikely others will bid above $20 given their maximum possible value. This bid is not dominated as it ensures winning while paying slightly above the highest possible competing bid.

Since my value for the prize is $23, I should bid slightly below this to maximize profit if I win. Bidding exactly $23 is dominated because if I win, I will break even or lose money. I should bid slightly above the midpoint between $10 and $23, around $16, to increase my chances of winning while ensuring a positive profit if I win.
